vote.question: On the Joint Resolution
vote.senate_document_text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Waste Emissions Charge for Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems: Procedures for Facilitating Compliance, Including Netting and Exemptions".

object.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Waste Emissions Charge for Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems: Procedures for Facilitating Compliance, Including Netting and Exemptions".
object.passage_action_text: Received in the Senate, read twice, considered, read the third time, and passed without amendment by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 47. Record Vote Number: 97. (consideration: CR S1419)

cra.rule_title: Waste Emissions Charge for Petroleum and Natural Gas Systems: Procedures for Facilitating Compliance, Including Netting and Exemptions
cra.consequence_ref: Congressional Review Act, 5 U.S.C. 801(b): a rule disapproved by an enacted joint resolution shall not take effect (or shall not continue in effect) and may not be reissued in substantially the same form without subsequent statutory authorization.

receipt.heading_failure: If the resolution does not pass
receipt.yea_means: A Yea vote is a vote to pass the joint resolution in the Senate.
receipt.nay_means: A Nay vote is a vote against passing the joint resolution.
